eight_serious_rivals.complete_own_argument: The talent-first reading explains why others rely on her and why UZQueen recognition matters. It fails if talent becomes sufficient explanation: console curiosity, wanted leisure and scripted-game emotion are ends without an audience’s reward, while format-specific movement difficulty and current café errors resist universal mastery.

The exposure-as-cure reading can point to completed work, some courage and actual public participation. It cannot absorb the declined next shift, continued stranger fear, repeated misunderstood endings, “もう無理です,” or requested crowd escape. These are contrary endpoints, not temporary noise that a presumed final cure may erase.

The adult-rescue reading has genuine evidence in comfort, privacy, shared play and extraction after help requested. It becomes excessive when it ignores omitted job information, misfiring reassurance and observer pressure, or the peer-led arcade action without Sensei. Aid is significant without monopolizing agency or providing one best intervention.

The exploitation-only reading rightly notices pressured attendance, uninformed work and unwanted publicity. But it would also erase self-chosen modelling, an invitation to leisure, honored disc privacy, volunteered matches, meaningful work pleasure and shared game-world attention. Recognizing those goods does not excuse the specific pressure that remains beside them.

The helpless-withdrawal reading fits concealment and social distress but not her material contributions, quick data preservation, volunteered competition, puzzle/scouting work or request for an apology. Equally, calling every concealment strategic would suppress actual fear. The evidence supports different relations to exposure, not one hidden motive for all retreats.

The instrumental-ordinary-life reading treats hobbies, gifts and comfort as useful chiefly because they prepare crisis performance. The sources explicitly value an enjoyable day, nearby joy, warm routine, creative memory and a shared peaceful game world. Some work and rescue really are helped by these relations, but their worth does not depend on a later institutional result.

The unified-growth biography gains apparent simplicity from shared names, profile similarities and recurring motifs. It fails the literal two-key binding, unresolved group join, release/in-world distinction and repeated contrary endings. Comparison remains possible, but the bridge is an argument about parallel decisions and audiences rather than a repaired registry or a dated maturation ladder.

The games-are-unreal dismissal has a valid warning against treating virtual victory as actual assault or NPC thanks as proven personhood. It goes too far if it denies the player’s felt choice, cooperation and pleasure.20055:006 names the scripted ending precisely while valuing experience; MAIN’s Alice conflict is a different source problem and cannot be solved by either analogy or dismissal.
